messages:
laura_finance: Heads-up — customer dispute: Azure invoice shows 160 seats but partner portal shows staggered activations totalling ~112. Need meterline audit.

matt_partner_success: oh no. do we have subscription id + invoice id?

laura_finance: sub: sub-9f8e7d6c, invoice INV-2026-04-02-sub-9f8e7d6c. Partner logs say activations across 2026-03-20 -> 2026-03-30. Invoice snapshot is 2026-03-21 00:00 UTC.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-04-02-sub-9f8e7d6c created for $5,760.00 (160 seats @ $36). Billing period: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31.

sophia_ops: paste meterline export please, need timestamps and seat deltas to reconcile snapshot vs portal.

laura_finance: meterlines (redacted):
2026-03-21T00:00:00Z,sub-9f8e7d6c,seats:48
2026-03-22T05:14:33Z,sub-9f8e7d6c,seats:+20
2026-03-24T11:02:10Z,sub-9f8e7d6c,seats:+24
2026-03-27T16:55:41Z,sub-9f8e7d6c,seats:+20
2026-03-29T23:59:59Z,sub-9f8e7d6c,seats:+48

laura_finance: you can see totals reach 160 by 3/29 but invoice snapshot ran at 3/21 so should've captured 48, maybe 68 if ingestion had earlier event timestamps.

raj_billing: possible root causes: 1) partner sent historical events with ingestion timestamps after snapshot (backfill) 2) duplicate/merged meterline entries during connector replay 3) timezone offset bug when snapshotting.

matt_partner_success: contacting partner-ops now. Also, let's prepare an interim credit: finance ok to provisionally credit difference up to $4k pending final audit.

sophia_ops: I'll run connector ingestion logs for 03/20-03/22 window and check SQS/replay retries. Will also check if our snapshot job used local TZ config.

billing-bot: Created ticket TCK-4921: "Azure marketplace ingestion/backfill investigation - sub-9f8e7d6c" assigned to eng-ops.

laura_finance: AP will hold payment until we confirm. I'll draft a provisional credit memo and flag for accounting review.

matt_partner_success: partner replied — they did a CSV backfill and pushed events on 2026-03-25 via their connector. Looks like backfill lacked historical ingestion timestamps. Escalating to their engineer.

raj_billing: provisional credit approved by finance lead for up to $4k. Laura add final numbers to TCK-4921 when reconciled.

laura_finance: will update TCK and close loop. Note to team: add a backfill detection check in ingestion pipeline (compare event.timestamp vs ingestion.time) so we can auto-flag late-arriving meterlines before invoice snapshot. :memo:

matt_partner_success: agree. thanks all. :thumbsup:
